observations: Photo 0: IBC tote tank with white plastic inner container and metal wire cage frame, blue plastic valve at base, sitting on a pallet-style plastic base.
Photo 0: Additional similar totes visible stacked/placed behind the main one.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same tote showing a red/white warning label on the plastic body and the blue ball-valve spigot; cage shows some light surface rust/weathering.
Photo 2: Close-up of embossed lettering on the plastic body, partially legible, appears to show numbers like '1000' and '250 LTR' possibly a date/batch code, not a clear volume certification.
No brand, manufacturer name, or certification plate clearly readable in any photo.

identity.kind: IBC tote tank (intermediate bulk container) for liquid storage

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: No certification, UN rating plate, or chemical compatibility marking is clearly visible in any photo; general IBC design is consistent with such use but condition/seal integrity cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Implied capacity around 1000L (based on embossed marking in photo 2)
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows partial embossed text that may read '1000' but is not fully legible or confirmed as a volume certification mark.

risks.risk: Cage or weld corrosion that could fail under load, not clear from photos due to distance/angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four cage corners and welds, plus the base pallet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having moderate rust risk, not structurally guaranteed

risks.risk: Valve/spigot functionality (leaks, cracks, or stuck mechanism) cannot be confirmed from static photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the valve being opened and closed with water flow.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve not confirmed working

risks.risk: Plastic bladder may have micro-cracks, prior chemical residue, or odor from previous contents, which affects suitability for new liquids.
risks.proof: Interior photo looking down into the tank opening, and seller's disclosure of prior contents.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown prior use, lower than food-grade or virgin tote

risks.risk: Actual volume capacity unconfirmed (could be a non-standard size despite embossed marking).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the manufacturer's data plate or embossed capacity marking, unobstructed.
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest plausible standard IBC size (lower end)

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the manufacturer data plate or embossed capacity/certification marking.
Video of the valve opening and closing with liquid flow.
Photo looking into the tank opening to check interior condition and residue.
Close-up photos of all cage corners and the base pallet for rust/damage assessment.
Seller's disclosure of what liquid was previously stored in the tote.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used IBC tote tank; despite unverified capacity and condition claims, it can be priced at worst case (unconfirmed size, unconfirmed valve function, unknown prior contents) pending further proof.
